entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • DisplayAlertAsync throws NullReferenceException when page is no longer displayed #33287
  • Static Web Assets from transitive NuGet dependencies fail to render/load on iOS but work on Windows in MAUI Blazor Hybrid #33286
  • MediaPicker.PickPhotosAsync throwing TaskCancelledException in net10-android #33283
  • Add page level style makes the label invisible on Windows #33280

Closed

  • MSIX Publish Fails in Visual Studio When Project References Multi-Target MAUI Class Library #33255
